svg.aria-label: How far each word lets the agent go: four steps up. goforit builds the plan; goforitreally also merges on green and writes veto lines; carteblanche also picks its own work and starts sessions; trescarteblanche does it in more than one project. The steps go from teal to deep red as the agent may do more alone. Always yours, on every step: ratify, taste, main, public.
